facts.fact: The Central Bank of Libya regulates mobile and e-wallet payment by circular: Circular 9/2026 of 11 March 2026 sets e-wallet rules for banks, Moamalat and e-payment companies, with compliance checked by field inspection by its banking and currency supervision department.

LBY.note: Circular sets transfer caps and onboarding requirements; no conduct rule or complaints body stated.
No government payment to people stated.
No survey share of adults stated.

facts.fact: Circular 9/2026 of the Central Bank of Libya lets licensed e-payment companies issue e-wallets, including to legally resident foreigners, with daily transfer caps of 100,000 dinars person to person, 500,000 person to company and 2 million company to company for citizens.

LBY.note: No tax or fee payment stated.
